Subject: New vendor onboarding — tax forms attached

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding runbook last week. We're getting set up in your vendor portal and attached our completed W-8BEN-E (signed). The form is in Spanish and our company registry is in Mexico (RFC/EIN equivalent). We don't have a notarized bank letter on hand but can get one in ~7 business days.

Questions for your team:
- Will you accept the Spanish W-8BEN-E with an apostille and a certified translation, or do you need a US-format W-9 instead?
- Are there any interim steps so we can receive a provisional PO to start the integration work while full tax evidence is processed?

Attached: SupplyPay_W8BEN-E_signed_spanish.pdf

Best,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Finance
SupplyPay Inc.

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@supplypay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax forms attached

Hi Carlos — thanks for sending these over and welcome aboard. A few notes so we can keep this moving: 

1) Tax classification: because SupplyPay is Mexico-registered, we accept a completed W-8BEN-E. The Spanish form is fine if you provide: (a) an apostille OR notarized copy, and (b) a certified English translation of the completed fields. We occasionally accept a registry screenshot from SAT (official taxpayer registry) when accompanied by the form — see #3.

2) TIN/EIN verification: to confirm tax ID, acceptable evidence includes (any one):
   - Official government registry screenshot (SAT) with company name + RFC, OR
   - Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name and tax ID, OR
   - Notarized affidavit from an authorized signer + certified translation.

3) Timeline & provisional PO: Procurement can provisionally issue a PO up to $10,000 for implementation work while we await full verification, provided:
   - We have a legible W-8BEN-E (with translation/apostille), AND
   - A timeline from you for the bank letter (or alternate verification), AND
   - Payments has reviewed the sample invoice and bank details.

I've looped in Kimberly (procurement) to confirm acceptance criteria and Monica (payments) for bank detail review.

If you prefer to accelerate, uploading the SAT registry screenshot + bank letter (even a draft) speeds review.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: (none)

Date: 2026-07-20T11:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax forms attached

Hi all — quick confirmation from procurement side:

We will accept the Spanish W-8BEN-E if you provide an apostille OR a notarized copy plus a certified English translation of the populated fields (company name, tax ID, authorized signer, signature/date).

For the provisional PO:
- I can approve a one-time provisional PO up to $10k that covers the first implementation milestone. That PO will be marked "conditional — tax evidence pending."
- The provisional PO will convert to a final PO (and release larger amounts) once Monica confirms bank details and one of the acceptable TIN proofs is received.

Please upload the translation as a separate file and confirm which signer will be on the bank letter so Payments can match signatures.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@supplypay.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax forms attached

Hi Carlos — Payments here. A couple of practical notes so we avoid rework: 

- Bank letter should be on bank letterhead, include company legal name, account number (partial ok, last 4 digits fine), and the tax ID (RFC). A scanned PDF from the issuing bank is acceptable.
- If you expect ACH/SEPA to be used, include an IBAN or CLABE as relevant.
- We can accept a provisional bank confirmation email from the bank if it has the bank reference number and officer contact — we'll treat that as interim while we get the formal letter.

Once we have the bank evidence and the translated W-8BEN-E, I will confirm and request Procurement to finalize the PO ceiling.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Payments Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
